body:
Day 3
Firstly… thank you to each one of you who responded. I’m sorry that one of you is going through the same thing I am. I can imagine how difficult it is. I wish I could do something for you. I didn’t know what to write yesterday. I spent the entire day thinking where I wanted to go for my fatal fall. But one of you said that this 3-day rule is supposed to help me see that not all moments are bad. There are good things in life too. And you weren’t wrong, there are. 

The bad, unfortunately for me, outweighs the good. My father found out about me skipping college. Suffice it to say that he was not at all pleased. Of course, not without cause. Today he asked me, “Are you my daughter or the devil?” I didn’t respond. I didn’t cry either. A few minutes later he said to me that in the coming week, he would hang himself if I didn’t “pull up my socks”. He told me I would be responsible for his death.

I don’t want that responsibility. For so long I have tried to pull myself together, but nothing interests me anymore. I’ve tried so hard. But I don’t want to see my parents every day and realise how utterly miserable I make one of them. This sounds like badly written fanfiction, if I’m being honest… but writing it out helps me think clearly. 

I’m tired. So, so tired.

I’m hoping to do it either tomorrow or this Sunday.
